derivation: from the dual of H7413 (רָמָה) and the plural of the active participle of H6822 (צָפָה); double height of watchers;

occurrences.text: Now there was a certain man of Ramathaim–zophim, of mount Ephraim, and his name was Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Elihu, the son of Tohu, the son of Zuph, an Ephrathite:
